name: INFINITUS EVE ÆTERNAL
source:
INFINITUS EVE ÆTERNAL is an AI visual novel that explores the themes of God, religion, good practices, life, and the mysteries that surround humanity and nature while diving deep into the realms of spirituality, morality, and environmental sustainability.

As players progress through the game, they will learn about different religious practices, philosophies and beliefs, and they will be presented with various moral dilemmas that challenge their understanding of right and wrong. Through their choices, players will shape the outcome of the story, creating their unique narrative that reflects their values and beliefs.

The main objective of this game is to educate players on sustainable practices that can help protect the planet, providing a platform for promoting awareness and encouraging action.

[Edited from [url=https://lucifilms.itch.io/infinituseve]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《无限夏娃永恒》是一部人工智能视觉小说，探索上帝、宗教、良好实践、生命以及围绕人类和自然的奥秘，同时深入探讨灵性、道德和环境可持续性领域。

随着游戏的进展，玩家将了解不同的宗教习俗、哲学和信仰，并且会面临各种道德困境，挑战他们对是非的理解。通过他们的选择，玩家将塑造故事的结果，创造反映他们价值观和信仰的独特叙事。

该游戏的主要目标是教育玩家了解有助于保护地球的可持续实践，并提供一个提高认识和鼓励行动的平台。

[编辑自[url=https://lucifilms.itch.io/infinituseve]Itch.io[/url]]
